name: gen-connect-fixtures
description: Signed-fixture generator for the watchpay Connect adapter tests. Pins @trezor/connect 9.7.3 (the bridge contract this adapter models) and uses @ethereumjs/tx — the exact serialization family @trezor/connect itself depends on ('@ethereumjs/tx': '^10.1.0' in its package.json) — to sign deterministic synthetic transactions offline. No SDK initialization, no device, no network calls of any kind: npm install fetches the packages, then the script runs purely locally.
